messages:
sophia: Quick sync — we observed a warm-start path that occasionally OOMs on older T4 packs with the new matmul kernel + quant build. Need a coordinated rollforward with a safety pin plan. Suggest canary 5% EU -> 25% -> global across a 3h night window (00:30-03:30 UTC).

oliver: Ack. Can you paste the kernel + quant build ids? I want to check perf diffs vs prev.

maria: we repro'ed once on staging with long KV cache cold start and heavy batch spikes. Not consistent. Logs attached in staging-thread.

sophia: Kernel: engine-kernel-v2.11-abiB, Quant: quant-rlq-1.3. Build artifacts: gcs://redwood-builds/eng/2026/02/quant-rlq-1.3.tar.gz

kai: If it's rare, i'd prefer staged rollforward with pin TTL for regions that hit OOMs. Pin command: `deploybot pin --service eng-runtime --region eu-west-1 --ttl 6h --why "warmstart OOM mitigation" --version engine-kernel-v2.10`

tim: +1 to pin TTL approach. Also propose adding a compatibility flag that forces the old GEMM path for nodes reporting <16GB mem until we get better kernel fallback. Could be a config flag: `runtime.feature.force_legacy_gemm=true`

oliver: Are we confident quant-rlq-1.3 is the trigger? Could be kernel matmul changes. Let's run a quick diff job against a traced warm-start log. I can run a 10x replay on a small pool.

sophia: OK oliver — start the replay. If error rate >0.5% on canary, immediate rollback plan. Rollback plan: 1) deploybot rollback target to engine-kernel-v2.10 (region pinned) 2) revert quant to 1.2 if needed 3) enable legacy GEMM flag globally as temporary mitigation.

deploy-bot: [INFO] canary rollout queued: service=eng-runtime, version=engine-kernel-v2.11-abiB, target=eu-west-1, percent=5

infra-bot: [ALERT] nodepool eu-west-1-t4-lowmem: 2/120 nodes reported OOM signals in the last 10m (logs: https://internal.logs/efs/xxxxx)

maria: replay started by @oliver — job id replay-20260320-78. Will post results in ~12m.

oliver: replay done. Error spike at 4.2% with kv-cache warmstart pattern. Reproduces on T4-lowmem only.

kai: recommend immediate pin for eu-west-1 and reduce canary to 0% until we sort. Executing pin now.

deploy-bot: [ACTION] pin applied: service=eng-runtime, region=eu-west-1, pinned_version=engine-kernel-v2.10, ttl=6h, applied_by=kai

sophia: Good. Tim please draft release-note blurb: "Temporarily pinned kernel in eu-west-1 due to rare warm-start OOMs observed with engine-kernel-v2.11 + quant-rlq-1.3; working on graceful GEMM fallback. Affected: T4 low-memory node types."

tim: Drafted and pushed to release-notes/3470012345.md.

maria: Ops: We'll monitor for recurrence. If no new OOMs in 6h, we can try a limited canary with legacy_gemm flag disabled to isolate quant vs kernel.

sophia: Thanks all. Post-mortem checklist: update canary gating to include node-memory-distribution signal, add automated replay harness as part of PRs touching matmul, and schedule a follow-up runbook edit. Will schedule 30m sync tomorrow 09:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
